behavior.rules: Versioned minimum independent matches, required keywords and exclusions; normalized duplicate/conflict/secret checks. Legacy advice remains readable. Structured rules persist through edit, toggle, restart, publication and rollback.
behavior.matching: English whole-word/phrase/tool-identifier boundaries, Chinese phrases, NFKC/case/whitespace normalization, bounded explicit local negation, overlapping-term deduplication, specificity ranking discounted by keyword-list size. The same selector runs live and in regression validation.
behavior.candidates: AI candidate prompt/schema supports structured applicability and hard negative cases with shared keywords. Candidate-only; user review and validation still required before publication.
behavior.evaluation: Evaluator 1.1.0. Historical 1.0.0 reports remain readable; unpublished candidates require new validation after matcher upgrade.
behavior.limits: Project/source/current-revision guards, pause/archive, max three entries, context byte limits and provider-session reset remain enforced.
limitations: Deterministic lexical rules, not full semantic understanding. Descriptive condition text is not executable; configure structured rules to narrow existing broad advice.
No real-task improvement percentage or live-provider quality benchmark is claimed.
